title: Add kerb ramp at Junction 3 (Route A)
rationale: Removes the only step on the shortest route from Block A to the clinic.

title: Resurface broken path near Grocery
rationale: Replaces broken paving that wheelchair and stroller users must avoid.

title: Covered walkway Block C to Bus Stop
rationale: Gives senior residents shelter from sun and rain on the walk to the bus stop.

title: New link path through park (design mode)
rationale: Adds a new step-free link to the park; exists only as a design-mode proposal.

title: Tactile paving along Route B (J6 to Clinic)
rationale: Helps visually impaired users follow the longer clinic route.

title: Regrade steep link Junction 4 to Junction 3
rationale: Brings the slope down from about 11 percent to within the wheelchair and stroller limits.

title: Night lighting on Junction 6 to Junction 7
rationale: Adds lighting to an unlit path that residents use after dark.
